newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia wants heavy penalty for accused actress.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia wants heavy penalty for accused actress.

text.p: Indonesia called on Wednesday for heavy punishment for an actress accused of possessing ecstasy pills who was arrested in the United States after fleeing police custody in Jakarta.

Attorney General Singgih said it was hoped the actress Zarima could be extradited and tried in Indonesia for the drugs possesion offence, and for escaping Indonesian police custody, after she was caught on Monday in a Houston supermarket.
"She ran away during the investigation and so she must be punished very hard. We hope we will be able to try her here in Indonesia, " Singgih told reporters before a monthly cabinet meeting.

Indonesia does not have an extradition treaty with the United States, but police said on Tuesday Zarima's passport had been withdrawn by the Indonesian government and her entry into the United States was illegal.
Zarima, 24, was detained in August after police said they found 29,667 pills of the designer drug ecstasy in her home.
The actress, who had appeared in small roles in several local television serials, escaped a short while later after asking if she could go home for a bath.
Armed forces chief General Feisal Tanjung praised the cooperation between the Indonesian police and the U.S. Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI).
"This is proof we are serious about handling cases like this," Tanjung told reporters.
He said authorities would continue to search for businessman Eddy Tansil, who escaped from prison in early May after being sentenced to 20 years prison in a high-profile banking scandal.
